question: A charge of $24\,\text{C}$ passes through a cross-section of a metallic conductor in $2\,\text{min}$. Calculate the current and explain the role of free electrons in producing it.

options.A:
$I=12\,\text{A}$
Current is produced because positive ions drift through the metallic conductor.
options.B:
$I=0.2\,\text{A}$
Current is produced by the drift of free electrons under the applied electric field.
options.C:
$I=0.4\,\text{A}$
Current is produced because free electrons move randomly without an electric field.
options.D:
$I=0.1\,\text{A}$
Current is produced by stationary free electrons.
